name.ja: 【 仮面ライダー45周年記念特別企画 】 MG FIGURE-RISE 1/8 仮面ライダー新１号（スペシャルメッキＶｅｒ．）
name.en: [Kamen Rider 45th Anniversary Special Project] MG FIGURE-RISE 1/8 Kamen Rider New No. 1 (Special Plated Ver.)

series.ja: 仮面ライダーシリーズ

description.ja: 仮面ライダー４５周年記念！ＭＧフィギュアライズ 仮面ライダー再び！圧倒的なクオリティに注目せよ！
description.en: Kamen Rider 45th Anniversary! MG Figurerise Kamen Rider again! Pay attention to the overwhelming quality!

description.ja: 仮面ライダー４５周年を記念して、各所にメッキ加工を施したスペシャル仕様の仮面ライダー新１号を、
description.en: To commemorate Kamen Rider's 45th lap, we have released Kamen Rider New No. 1 with a special specification that has been plated in various parts.

description.ja: 「ＭＧフィギュアライズ 仮面ライダー」シリーズで商品化。メモリアル商品にふさわしい輝きを放つ、豪華仕様！
description.en: Commercialized in the "MG Figurerise Kamen Rider" series. Luxurious specifications that give off a shine suitable for a memorial product!

description.ja: ●　パーツごとに異なる配色・質感のメッキを採用し、劇中を再現！
description.en: ● Each part is plated with a different color scheme and texture to recreate the scene in the play!

description.ja: マットな質感とツヤ有、２つの異なる質感のメッキを組み合わせて細部まで表現！
description.en: Combining two different plating textures, matte and glossy, to express every detail!

description.ja: ヘルメット…
description.en: helmet...

description.ja: 特徴的なヘルメットはライトグリーンメッキで再現。
description.en: The characteristic helmet is reproduced with light green plating.

description.ja: 劇中の設定を再現できる、絶妙な配色のメッキを採用。
description.en: Adopts exquisite color plating that can reproduce the settings in the play.

description.ja: ベルト…
description.en: belt...

description.ja: 精密なディテールを際立たせる、ツヤ有りのレッドのメッキを採用。
description.en: Adopts glossy red plating that highlights precise details.

description.ja: 胴体部分…
description.en: Body part...

description.ja: マットな質感のグリーンメッキで加工。
description.en: Processed with green plating with a matte texture.

description.ja: 腕部分…
description.en: Arm part...

description.ja: 艶消しのシルバーメッキを使用。
description.en: Uses matte silver plating.

description.ja: ●　ＭＧフィギュアライズならではの圧倒的な可動領域で、劇中ポーズの再現が可能！
description.en: ● With the overwhelming range of motion unique to MG Figurerise, it is possible to reproduce poses from the movie!

description.ja: 肘と膝は２重関節で大きく可動し、躍動感のあるポーズを再現可能。
description.en: The elbows and knees have double joints that allow for wide movement, allowing for dynamic poses.

description.ja: さらに腰部分に回転する可動を取り入れ、人体に近い自然な動きを表現。
description.en: Furthermore, the waist part has rotational movement to express natural movements similar to those of the human body.

description.ja: ●　クリアパーツに背面からモールドを施し、特徴的な目を再現！
description.en: ● The clear parts are molded from the back to reproduce the distinctive eyes!

description.ja: ●　豊富な手パーツや、指の可動で、変身ポーズ等印象深いシーンのポージングが可能！
description.en: ● With a variety of hand parts and movable fingers, you can pose impressive scenes such as transformation poses!

description.ja: 指は１本１本可動し、色々な表現が可能。さらにアクション用の平手（左右）も付属。
description.en: Each finger can be moved, allowing for various expressions. Furthermore, open hands (left and right) for action are also included.

description.ja: ●　動きのあるポーズにあわせて、マフラーは風になびいた状態での固定も！
description.en: ● The muffler can also be fixed while waving in the wind to match the moving pose!

description.ja: マフラーは垂らした状態と風になびいた状態の２つのパーツが付属。
description.en: The muffler comes with two parts: one hanging down and one waving in the wind.

description.ja: ●　変身ベルトは、色分けされた精密パーツとこだわりの造形で細部まで再現！
description.en: ● The transformation belt is reproduced in detail with color-coded precision parts and careful modeling!

description.ja: ●　専用台座が付属し、宙に浮いた状態でディスプレイ可能！ライダーキックも再現可能！
description.en: ● Comes with a special pedestal so you can display it floating in the air! Rider kick can also be reproduced!

description.ja: １／８スケール組み立て式プラモデル
description.en: 1/8 Scale Assembly type plastic model

description.ja: 対象年齢：１５才以上
description.en: Target age: 15 years old and above

description.ja: 製品素材：ＰＳ・ＰＥ・ＡＢＳ・合成ゴム
description.en: Product material: PS, PE, ABS, synthetic rubber

description.ja: ・組み立てに接着剤は使用しません。また、専用台座の組み立てには、＋（プラス）ドライバーが必要です。
description.en: ・No adhesive is used in the assembly. Also, the dedicated pedestal assembly requires a + (Philips) screwdriver.
